items.title: A finite locally free module on an integral scheme can be filtered after a modification
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file divisors.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a finite locally free module E on an integral scheme X there is a modification f : X' -> X such that f^*E has a filtration with invertible successive quotients (source lines 9412-9418). The proof is an induction on the rank: it forms P = P(E), uses the canonical surjection pi^*E -> O_P(1) with finite locally free kernel of rank r-1, takes the scheme theoretic image X' of a section over a trivialising open U (integral, proper over X and an isomorphism over U, hence a modification), reads off the two-step filtration and applies the induction hypothesis to the kernel.
